summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K (home-country disclosure mapped to a US current report) on September 14, 2026, disclosing that the USFDA completed a records assessment under Section 704(a)(4) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act at its API facility in Jiutepec, Morelos, Mexico. The assessment ran from July 17, 2026 to September 8, 2026 and concluded with a Form FDA 2953 containing two observations. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics were disclosed, and no transaction is involved; the filing is a routine regulatory-compliance update. No risk-arb angle applies.
